caption: A person carries a full bucket of water in one hand and leans the body to the other side to balance the load.

sa.check: A person carries a bucket of water in one hand.
They lean their body to the other side.

pc.expect: The lean is away from the bucket and appears as soon as it is lifted.
pc.fail: They lean toward the bucket; or walk upright as if it weighed nothing; or lean before lifting it.

pc.expect: The bucket's weight shows: the arm is straight and the shoulder drops.
pc.fail: The arm is bent casually; or the bucket floats; or the bucket swings up.

pc.expect: The water level in the bucket stays flat, sloshing a little.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or spills upward; or tilts steeply.

pc.expect: The body bends at the joints.
pc.fail: It folds mid-torso; or a limb detaches; or the arm stretches.

pc.expect: Their limbs keep their number, and one bucket stays one bucket.
pc.fail: A limb vanishes; or the bucket duplicates; or they merge with the bucket.

pc.expect: Their clothing and the bucket stay the same.
pc.fail: The clothing changes colour; or the bucket changes; or the background rearranges.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Form, posture and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
